import datetime
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# 1. Create a cover page PDF
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

title = "Annual Financial Report"
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# Title, centered, bold
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 60, title)

# Date below title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 10, today)

c.save()
print(f"Cover page created: {cover_path} ({today})")

# 2. Merge cover page with report.pdf
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print(f"Original report pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Output: {output_path} with {len(writer.pages)} pages total")

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using pure Python.

Strategy (no PDF libraries available):
1. Build a minimal, valid cover-page object set (page, fonts, text stream).
2. Parse report.pdf (classic xref table, uncompressed objects) and copy all of
   its objects verbatim, patching the single page's /Parent to the new pages root.
3. Write a new merged PDF: report objects (1-8), cover objects (9-12),
   new pages root (13), new catalog (14), then a fresh xref table + trailer.
4. Re-parse the output and verify structure and byte-exact stream copies.
"""

import datetime
import re
import sys

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

DATE = datetime.date.today()
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = DATE.strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def esc_pdf_text(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def center_x(text: str, font_size: float, page_w: float = 612.0) -> float:
    # Approximate Helvetica advance: ~0.5 em per character on average.
    approx_w = len(text) * font_size * 0.5
    return (page_w - approx_w) / 2.0


def parse_xref(data: bytes) -> dict:
    """Return {obj_number: file_offset} from a classic xref table."""
    xref_start = data.rfind(b"xref")
    if xref_start == -1:
        raise ValueError("No classic xref table found")
    trailer_pos = data.find(b"trailer", xref_start)
    section = data[xref_start:trailer_pos]
    lines = section.splitlines()
    entries = {}
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if re.fullmatch(rb"\d+ \d+", line):
            start, count = (int(x) for x in line.split())
            for j in range(count):
                i += 1
                m = re.match(rb"(\d{10}) (\d{5}) ([nf])", lines[i])
                if m and m.group(3) == b"n":
                    entries[start + j] = int(m.group(1))
        i += 1
    return entries


def read_object(data: bytes, offset: int):
    """Parse one object. Returns (num, dict_part_bytes, stream_data_or_None)."""
    head = data[offset:]
    m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b", head)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Bad object header at offset {offset}")
    num = int(m.group(1))
    body = head[m.end():]
    stream_m = re.search(rb"stream(?=\r?\n)", body)
    endobj_pos = body.find(b"endobj")
    if stream_m and (endobj_pos == -1 or stream_m.start() < endobj_pos):
        dict_part = body[:stream_m.start()]
        length_m = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)", dict_part)
        if not length_m:
            raise ValueError(f"Object {num}: no /Length in stream dict")
        length = int(length_m.group(1))
        after_kw = stream_m.end()
        if body[after_kw:after_kw + 2] == b"\r\n":
            stream_start = after_kw + 2
        elif body[after_kw:after_kw + 1] == b"\n":
            stream_start = after_kw + 1
        else:
            stream_start = after_kw
        stream_data = body[stream_start:stream_start + length]
        return num, dict_part, stream_data
    else:
        return num, body[:endobj_pos], None


def build_cover_objects():
    """Return {obj_num: body_bytes} for the cover page (numbers 9-12)."""
    content = (
        "BT\n"
        f"/F2 28 Tf\n"
        f"{center_x(TITLE, 28):.1f} 450 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_text(TITLE)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 16 Tf\n"
        f"{center_x(DATE_STR, 16):.1f} 400 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_text(DATE_STR)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "q\n"
        "2 w\n"
        "72 380 m\n"
        "540 380 l\n"
        "S\n"
        "Q\n"
    )
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")

    page = (
        "<<\n"
        "/Type /Page\n"
        "/Parent 13 0 R\n"
        "/MediaBox [0 0 612 792]\n"
        "/Resources << /Font << /F1 10 0 R /F2 11 0 R >> /ProcSet [/PDF /Text] >>\n"
        "/Contents 12 0 R\n"
        ">>\n"
    )
    font_regular = "<< /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /Name /F1 /Subtype /Type1 /Type /Font >>\n"
    font_bold = "<< /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /Name /F2 /Subtype /Type1 /Type /Font >>\n"
    contents = (
        f"<< /Length {len(content_bytes)} >>\n"
        "stream\n"
        f"{content}"
        "endstream\n"
    )
    return {9: page, 10: font_regular, 11: font_bold, 12: contents}


def main():
    print(f"Current date used on cover: {DATE_STR}")

    with open(INPUT, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    xref = parse_xref(data)
    print(f"Parsed xref: {len(xref)} in-use objects: {sorted(xref)}")

    report_objects = {}
    for num, off in sorted(xref.items()):
        onum, dict_part, stream_data = read_object(data, off)
        if onum != num:
            raise ValueError(f"Object number mismatch at offset {off}: {onum} != {num}")
        if stream_data is not None:
            body = dict_part + b"stream\n" + stream_data + b"\nendstream\n"
        else:
            body = dict_part + b"\n"
        report_objects[num] = (body, stream_data)

    body4, stream4 = report_objects[4]
    patched, n = re.subn(rb"/Parent\s+7\s+0\s+R", b"/Parent 13 0 R", body4)
    if n != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one /Parent patch in obj 4, got {n}")
    report_objects[4] = (patched, stream4)

    cover_objects = build_cover_objects()

    pages_root = "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [9 0 R 4 0 R] /Count 2 >>\n"
    catalog = "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 13 0 R /PageMode /UseNone >>\n"

    out = bytearray()
    out += b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"

    offsets = {}

    def write_obj(num: int, body: bytes):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
        out += body
        out += b"endobj\n"

    for num in sorted(report_objects):
        write_obj(num, report_objects[num][0])
    for num in sorted(cover_objects):
        write_obj(num, cover_objects[num])
    write_obj(13, pages_root.encode("latin-1"))
    write_obj(14, catalog.encode("latin-1"))

    xref_offset = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 15\n"
    for i in range(15):
        if i in offsets:
            out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += (
        b"trailer\n"
        b"<<\n"
        b"/Root 14 0 R\n"
        b"/Info 6 0 R\n"
        b"/Size 15\n"
        b">>\n"
        b"startxref\n"
    )
    out += str(xref_offset).encode("latin-1") + b"\n%%EOF\n"

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT} ({len(out)} bytes, {len(offsets)} objects)")

    # ---------- Validation: re-parse the output ----------
    v = parse_xref(bytes(out))
    assert set(v) == set(range(1, 15)), f"xref mismatch: {sorted(v)}"
    objs = {}
    for num, off in v.items():
        onum, dpart, sdata = read_object(bytes(out), off)
        assert onum == num
        objs[num] = (dpart, sdata)

    # Catalog -> Pages -> Kids
    cat = objs[14][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Type /Catalog" in cat and "/Pages 13 0 R" in cat, cat
    proot = objs[13][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Type /Pages" in proot and "/Count 2" in proot and "/Kids [9 0 R 4 0 R]" in proot, proot
    page9 = objs[9][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Type /Page" in page9 and "/Parent 13 0 R" in page9 and "/Contents 12 0 R" in page9, page9
    page4 = objs[4][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Parent 13 0 R" in page4 and "/Parent 7 0 R" not in page4, page4

    # Cover content stream: length matches, contains title and date
    _, cover_stream = objs[12]
    assert cover_stream is not None
    text = cover_stream.decode("latin-1")
    assert TITLE in text and DATE_STR in text, text

    # Report content stream copied byte-exactly
    _, orig_stream = report_objects[8][1], None
    assert objs[8][1] == report_objects[8][1], "report content stream mismatch"

    print("VALIDATION PASSED: catalog/pages tree, cover page, parent links, streams OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using pure Python.

Strategy (no PDF libraries available):
1. Build a minimal, valid cover-page object set (page, fonts, text stream).
2. Parse report.pdf (classic xref table, uncompressed objects) and copy all of
   its objects verbatim, patching the single page's /Parent to the new pages root.
3. Write a new merged PDF: report objects (1-8), cover objects (9-12),
   new pages root (13), new catalog (14), then a fresh xref table + trailer.
4. Re-parse the output and verify structure and byte-exact stream copies.
"""

import datetime
import re

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

DATE = datetime.date.today()
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = DATE.strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def esc_pdf_text(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def center_x(text: str, font_size: float, page_w: float = 612.0) -> float:
    # Approximate Helvetica advance: ~0.5 em per character on average.
    approx_w = len(text) * font_size * 0.5
    return (page_w - approx_w) / 2.0


def parse_xref(data: bytes) -> dict:
    """Return {obj_number: file_offset} from a classic xref table."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])xref(?=\r?\n)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("No classic xref table found")
    xref_start = matches[-1].start()
    trailer_pos = data.find(b"trailer", xref_start)
    if trailer_pos == -1:
        raise ValueError("No trailer keyword after xref table")
    section = data[xref_start:trailer_pos]
    lines = section.splitlines()
    entries = {}
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if re.fullmatch(rb"\d+ \d+", line):
            start, count = (int(x) for x in line.split())
            for j in range(count):
                i += 1
                m = re.match(rb"(\d{10}) (\d{5}) ([nf])", lines[i])
                if m and m.group(3) == b"n":
                    entries[start + j] = int(m.group(1))
        i += 1
    return entries


def read_object(data: bytes, offset: int):
    """Parse one object. Returns (num, dict_part_bytes, stream_data_or_None)."""
    head = data[offset:]
    m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b", head)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Bad object header at offset {offset}")
    num = int(m.group(1))
    body = head[m.end():]
    stream_m = re.search(rb"stream(?=\r?\n)", body)
    endobj_pos = body.find(b"endobj")
    if stream_m and (endobj_pos == -1 or stream_m.start() < endobj_pos):
        dict_part = body[:stream_m.start()]
        length_m = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)", dict_part)
        if not length_m:
            raise ValueError(f"Object {num}: no /Length in stream dict")
        length = int(length_m.group(1))
        after_kw = stream_m.end()
        if body[after_kw:after_kw + 2] == b"\r\n":
            stream_start = after_kw + 2
        elif body[after_kw:after_kw + 1] == b"\n":
            stream_start = after_kw + 1
        else:
            stream_start = after_kw
        stream_data = body[stream_start:stream_start + length]
        return num, dict_part, stream_data
    else:
        return num, body[:endobj_pos], None


def build_cover_objects():
    """Return {obj_num: body_bytes} for the cover page (numbers 9-12)."""
    content = (
        "BT\n"
        f"/F2 28 Tf\n"
        f"{center_x(TITLE, 28):.1f} 450 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_text(TITLE)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 16 Tf\n"
        f"{center_x(DATE_STR, 16):.1f} 400 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_text(DATE_STR)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "q\n"
        "2 w\n"
        "72 380 m\n"
        "540 380 l\n"
        "S\n"
        "Q\n"
    )
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")

    page = (
        "<<\n"
        "/Type /Page\n"
        "/Parent 13 0 R\n"
        "/MediaBox [0 0 612 792]\n"
        "/Resources << /Font << /F1 10 0 R /F2 11 0 R >> /ProcSet [/PDF /Text] >>\n"
        "/Contents 12 0 R\n"
        ">>\n"
    )
    font_regular = "<< /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /Name /F1 /Subtype /Type1 /Type /Font >>\n"
    font_bold = "<< /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /Name /F2 /Subtype /Type1 /Type /Font >>\n"
    contents = (
        f"<< /Length {len(content_bytes)} >>\n"
        "stream\n"
        f"{content}"
        "endstream\n"
    )
    return {9: page, 10: font_regular, 11: font_bold, 12: contents}


def main():
    print(f"Current date used on cover: {DATE_STR}")

    with open(INPUT, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    xref = parse_xref(data)
    print(f"Parsed xref: {len(xref)} in-use objects: {sorted(xref)}")

    report_objects = {}
    for num, off in sorted(xref.items()):
        onum, dict_part, stream_data = read_object(data, off)
        if onum != num:
            raise ValueError(f"Object number mismatch at offset {off}: {onum} != {num}")
        if stream_data is not None:
            body = dict_part + b"stream\n" + stream_data + b"\nendstream\n"
        else:
            body = dict_part + b"\n"
        report_objects[num] = (body, stream_data)

    # Patch report page (obj 4) /Parent 7 0 R -> /Parent 13 0 R (new pages root)
    body4, stream4 = report_objects[4]
    patched, n = re.subn(rb"/Parent\s+7\s+0\s+R", b"/Parent 13 0 R", body4)
    if n != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one /Parent patch in obj 4, got {n}")
    report_objects[4] = (patched, stream4)

    cover_objects = build_cover_objects()

    pages_root = "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [9 0 R 4 0 R] /Count 2 >>\n"
    catalog = "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 13 0 R /PageMode /UseNone >>\n"

    out = bytearray()
    out += b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"

    offsets = {}

    def write_obj(num: int, body: bytes):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out.extend(f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1"))
        out.extend(body)
        out.extend(b"endobj\n")

    for num in sorted(report_objects):
        write_obj(num, report_objects[num][0])
    for num in sorted(cover_objects):
        write_obj(num, cover_objects[num])
    write_obj(13, pages_root.encode("latin-1"))
    write_obj(14, catalog.encode("latin-1"))

    xref_offset = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 15\n"
    for i in range(15):
        if i in offsets:
            out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += (
        b"trailer\n"
        b"<<\n"
        b"/Root 14 0 R\n"
        b"/Info 6 0 R\n"
        b"/Size 15\n"
        b">>\n"
        b"startxref\n"
    )
    out += str(xref_offset).encode("latin-1") + b"\n%%EOF\n"

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT} ({len(out)} bytes, {len(offsets)} objects)")

    # ---------- Validation: re-parse the output ----------
    v = parse_xref(bytes(out))
    assert set(v) == set(range(1, 15)), f"xref mismatch: {sorted(v)}"
    objs = {}
    for num, off in v.items():
        onum, dpart, sdata = read_object(bytes(out), off)
        assert onum == num
        objs[num] = (dpart, sdata)

    # Catalog -> Pages -> Kids
    cat = objs[14][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Type /Catalog" in cat and "/Pages 13 0 R" in cat, cat
    proot = objs[13][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Type /Pages" in proot and "/Count 2" in proot and "/Kids [9 0 R 4 0 R]" in proot, proot
    page9 = objs[9][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Type /Page" in page9 and "/Parent 13 0 R" in page9 and "/Contents 12 0 R" in page9, page9
    page4 = objs[4][0].decode("latin-1")
    assert "/Parent 13 0 R" in page4 and "/Parent 7 0 R" not in page4, page4

    # Cover content stream: length matches, contains title and date
    cover_stream = objs[12][1]
    assert cover_stream is not None
    text = cover_stream.decode("latin-1")
    assert TITLE in text and DATE_STR in text, text

    # Report content stream copied byte-exactly
    assert objs[8][1] == report_objects[8][1], "report content stream mismatch"

    print("VALIDATION PASSED: catalog/pages tree, cover page, parent links, streams OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
